subtitle: Out Manila · Philippine Airlines
overview: Four nights in a 4-star Shanghai hotel. See the City God Temple business area, the world’s largest Starbucks Flagship, the LV mega ship, Nanjing Road, Wuzhen East Gate and The Bund, plus a free day for optional Disneyland. Flights are with Philippine Airlines.
travelDatesNote: Departures from Manila, Feb 26–Mar 2 2027 to Mar 19–23 2027. The rate changes by date: an amount on a date is added to the base rate per pax. Seats are limited and confirmed at booking.

items: Fly Manila to Shanghai (PR336 12:10/15:50 on Mar 17; PR338 06:15/09:50 on Feb 26, Mar 5, 12 and 19).
Meet the guide at the airport.
Visit the City God Temple business area.

items: Hotel breakfast.
Free and easy day (no service if you do not join an optional tour).

items: Hotel breakfast and check out.

placeDesc.City God Temple: A traditional-style business area around Shanghai's City God Temple with shops and snack stalls.
placeDesc.Starbucks Reserve Roastery Shanghai: A large Starbucks Reserve coffee roastery in Shanghai, visited as a sightseeing stop.
placeDesc.Nanjing Road: Shanghai's main pedestrian shopping street, open for free shopping time.
placeDesc.Wuzhen East Gate: The east gate of Wuzhen, a Jiangnan water town of canals and wooden houses.
placeDesc.The Bund: Shanghai's riverside promenade lined with historic buildings, with views across the Huangpu River.
placeDesc.Oriental Pearl Tower: A landmark TV tower in Pudong with spheres on its frame; viewed from outside.
